source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?length ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?l) AS ?length) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q12280 ; p:P2043/psn:P2043/wikibase:quantityAmount ?l . FILTER(?l >= 2000) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?c } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 329

country.match: Match each bridge to its country.
country.odd: Three of these bridges are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Golden Gate Bridge
rows.description: suspension bridge on the San Francisco Bay
rows.hook: is painted a famous shade of burnt orange and often disappears into fog

rows.label: Lake Pontchartrain Causeway
rows.description: set of two parallel bridges over Lake Pontchartrain in southern Louisiana, United States
rows.hook: is one of the longest continuous spans over open water in the world

rows.label: Mackinac Bridge
rows.description: suspension bridge connecting Michigan's Lower and Upper Peninsulas
rows.hook: links two peninsulas and is nicknamed Big Mac by locals

rows.label: Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge
rows.hook: is the finish-line backdrop for the start of a famous annual marathon

rows.label: Øresund Bridge
rows.description: road and railway bridge over Øresund
rows.hook: connects two Nordic countries, turning into an undersea tunnel partway across

rows.label: Gordie Howe International Bridge
rows.hook: is named after a legendary hockey player and links two countries

rows.label: Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge
rows.hook: is the longest one of its kind on the planet, stretching over open water and rice paddies

rows.label: Huajiang Canyon Bridge
rows.description: highest highway suspension bridge in Guizhou Province, China and the world
rows.hook: soars higher above its valley floor than almost any other of its kind on Earth

rows.label: Chesapeake Bay Bridge
rows.description: major dual-span bridge in the U.S. state of Maryland, spanning the Chesapeake Bay
rows.hook: carries traffic across a broad estuary on a dual span

rows.label: Confederation Bridge
rows.description: fixed link connecting Canadian province of Prince Edward Island with the mainland, at New Brunswick
rows.hook: curves gracefully across an icy strait, linking an island province to the mainland

rows.label: Sunshine Skyway Bridge
rows.description: bridge crossing the mouth of Tampa Bay, Florida, United States
rows.hook: has a bright yellow cable-stayed span soaring over a bay's mouth

rows.label: Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge
rows.description: fixed link consisting of tunnel and multiple bridges
rows.hook: links three cities across a sea using both bridges and an undersea tunnel
